name: audio-generation
description: 根据文字描述生成音频。调用已固定的 ElevenLabs sound-generation 接口；未配置 ELEVENLABS_API_KEY 时保持待配置。不朗读文字，也不改用其它产品。

api_key.title: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
api_key.description: User's own ElevenLabs API key, passed only as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. No default. Unset disables this MCP server and the script returns setup_required. Do not preset a key.
